purpose: Test whether explicit wake without torque/position writes resolves the repeated-position/nonzero-velocity state observed in dev_01 and dev_02.
session_intervention: Once per requested physics step, wake each existing articulation via installed dynamic-control API; no joint command or position teleport, no drive or physics parameter modification.
stop_gates: All dev_02 geometry, time, source consistency and settle gates unchanged; maximum 180 requested steps.
limits: A successful wake diagnostic would be qualified only for this declared wake policy, not an assertion that the normal scene is always awake.
